A member of an '''unidentified feathered species''' was among the prisoners of [[Stars' End/Legends|Stars' End]], killed by [[Security Police/Legends|Security Police]] during the [[Liberation of Stars' End]] in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]]. This species had feathers, a beak, and translucent blood.
